crossRefs.note: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is…
crossRefs.keyword: seeing, etc. or, and what root of matter is found in me?the root

translations.web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
translations.bsb: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’
translations.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found
translations.asv: If ye say, How we will persecute him! And that the root of the matter is found in me;
